name: gymcoach
description: GymCoach — build your own workout projects, log every set with custom columns, and export the whole record to an AI coach.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:build-android: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:build-ios: npm run build:web && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:run-android: npm run build:web && npx cap run android
scripts.cap:run-ios: npm run build:web && npx cap run ios
